name: fan-stack-motion
title: Fan Stack (Motion)
author: AlgorizeTech
description: Overlapping cards in a tilted diagonal cascade, dealt out of one pile into place as the stack scrolls into view. Use it for a short numbered sequence — steps, phases, a three-part system.
docs: Motion build of `fan-stack` — same props, markup and install path; install one or the other. Named exports: FanStack, FanStackCard, FanStackTitle, FanStackStep, FanStackDescription, FanStackPoints, FanStackPoint, FanStackThumb (plus the FanStackTone and FanStackThumbSide types). Compose cards as children — any number works; each card's `tone` (muted | light | accent) and its thumb's `side` (right | left | top) default by position. `FanStackThumb` takes your own `` or framework image as its child. Colours derive from `--primary`. The cascade is a container query: below 768px of width the cards become a CSS sticky stack, each sliding over the last (`stickyTop` clears a fixed header). The deal is scrubbed by scroll (`scrub` seconds of lag, 0 to lock it); pass `scrollerRef` when it scrolls inside a container. The deal is skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.
